text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
X Month, X Year
It has been a long time
coming for Nakayama
Festa's highly
anticipated entry in the Prix de
l'Arc de
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
She appeared in the paddock almost

unrecognizable, with an accentuated
character
and vigor unseen in any of her
races back at
home.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
She wasted no time during her long-term
trip,
having been seen diligently training
with other
Umamusume. She hit the
racecourse as if she'd
been running on
European turf her entire life.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
The support from the crowd was
overwhelming,
with everyone believing
first place was in her
grasp.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
If I had heard this story a year ago, I
would have
surely leapt with joy. Finally,
we found a winner
to represent Japan.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
But if someone had told me this story
two years
ago...

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text: I simply wouldn't have believed it.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Two years ago, while Nakayama Festa
certainly
showed some promise, she was
largely
overshadowed by several other
talents. Back
then, the spotlight shone
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
We all remember the stunt she had
pulled, but it
was seen as reckless rather
than brave.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Then, she continued to hone and
sharpen her
skills, eventually managing
to turn a faint glimmer
into a dazzling
light.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
There she was, standing in the paddock,
watched
over by her trainers.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
She returns a hand wave to a woman in
the stands
dressed in Japanese attire.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her in action has taught us how
to chase
our own dreams.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
She showed us the bravery required to
face the
stormy waves that life sends our
way.

text_block_list.name: Magazine Article
text_block_list.text:
She taught us how to tell a story of
ambition and
success.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
The sun has cast its blessing on Festa's
Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It really did! The downpour yesterday
had me
worried.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that rain has helped soften the
racecourse's
surface! Poor track
conditions give her an edge!
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Until two days ago, Paris had been all
sunny
skies, with not a drop of rain in
sight.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa performs better on soft
surfaces
than hard, so the unexpected
downpour was a
blessing in disguise.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely going to get first place
then!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...A miracle.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. This is the tale of miracles.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha, spare me the lecture. I'll head
back to the
paddock in a minute.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, Teach, and everyone else
here...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't take your eyes off me. I'm about
to make
history.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Old Homeroom Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Of course. I'll be watching you and you
only.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Right. See you all soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, on this day, a new chapter of
history is
written.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp... Chirp...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Nakayama, tell me again about the Arc!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hey, no fair, Dia! I want Nakayama to give me advice! 'Cause I'm gonna run in international races too!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You're better off going to El for something like that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
El is great at giving advice. She was my
teacher
too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Learning from my mentor's
mentor? That
sounds awesome!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I got it. But if El isn't around, I'll
be back
again to pick your brain,
okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Sure, sure. Just go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Popular? They're just eager to learn.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume like me want to spread our
wings
and head out into the world.
Seeing that,
nestlings are gonna want to
test their wings too,
right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of whether I fly or stay put,
there are
bound to be those who aren't
satisfied in little
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
The thrill of launching yourself into an
intense
battlefield and emerging
victorious never fades.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh. If that's how you want to think of
it, be my
guest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But, it's a bit too early to just leave my
mark and
pack up shop. Let me just tell
you that.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You still think there are
things for
me to achieve, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I like that answer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
All of the choices we make accumulate
to shape
who we are today.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
But, I still don't know where our true
finish line
lies. So you'd better stick with
me until the end.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You'd follow me all the way to hell,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa gives a cheeky grin. It'll
be my
loss if I run away here.
